name: ghost in the mirror
source:
an experimental game about a boy, a mirror in a dirty gas station bathroom, and his reflection. or is it his twin? 

who knows.

[From [url=https://labyrintheexe.itch.io/ghost-in-the-mirror]itch.io[/url]]
